title: External Nasdaq Composite trend full-capital BTC long/cash timing
thesis: Institutional participation has linked crypto risk appetite more closely to technology-oriented equity markets. Holding unlevered spot BTC only while the latest Nasdaq Composite close remains above its prior 200-business-day mean may avoid externally visible risk-off paths and improve drawdown and Calmar without forfeiting too much after-cost upside.
mechanism: Use the latest valid NASDAQCOM market close only after 00:00 UTC on the following calendar day. Compare that close with the simple mean of exactly the prior 200 valid business-day closes, excluding the current close. Hold 100-percent BTC while the relation is strictly positive and zero-yield cash otherwise; execute changed targets at the next H1 open. Test prior 150 and 250 business days only as frozen rejection neighbors.
economic_rationale: The policy is useful only if a technology-equity risk-appetite proxy avoids BTC drawdown and underwater paths enough to offset missed independent crypto rallies and repeated friction. Positive aggregate PnL or one successful 2022 exit is insufficient; Design, Validation, annual breadth, contribution concentration, realized/unrealized accounting, holding, terminal inventory and both neighboring horizons must support the same mechanism.
